hero.title: Pixel Crunch
hero.subtitle: Compress and optimize images directly in your browser.
hero.description: Your files never leave your device.

status.phase: Phase 1 completed. Coming soon: Compression engine (Phase 2).

privacy.title: Total Privacy
privacy.description: Your images are never uploaded to any server. All processing happens in your browser.

fast.title: Fast & Efficient
fast.description: Instant image compression using modern web technology.

free.title: Free & Open Source
free.description: Open source code, no usage limits, no subscriptions.

backgroundRemoval.uploadDescription: Drop them here or paste them from the clipboard.
backgroundRemoval.pasteLabel: You can also paste with Ctrl + V
backgroundRemoval.formatsLabel: JPG, PNG, or WebP · 25 MB maximum
backgroundRemoval.comparisonLabel: Compare the original image and result

original.label: Original · full size
original.description: Keeps the dimensions. Large photos use more memory.

optimized.label: Balanced · up to 4096 px
optimized.description: Recommended: limits the longest edge without enlarging small images.

reduced.label: Light · up to 2048 px
reduced.description: Limits the longest edge to use less memory, especially on phones.

backgroundRemoval.memoryNote: The image and result live only in memory on this page; they are removed when cleared or when the tab closes.
